Troubleshooting and FAQ

Source: vignettes/articles/troubleshooting.Rmd
troubleshooting.Rmd

Why did my license become 9 digits?

CCLD’s Transparency API expects facility numbers in a 9-digit form. Many public or local data files store the same number as 8 digits. ccld_pad() adds the leading zero so requests use the API’s canonical form.

ccld_pad("13423996")

Why does ccld_verify() return found = FALSE?

ccld_verify() keeps every input row. When the API does not return facility detail for a license, the row stays in the result with found = FALSE and missing facility fields. This makes failed matches visible after joins.

Why did ccld_pad() error?

License inputs must contain only digits and must be 9 digits or fewer.

ccld_pad("13423996")
ccld_pad(13423996)

Values such as "ABC123" or "0123456789" are rejected with a ccldr_invalid_input error.

Why are "small_fccs" and "centers" unsupported?

ccld_alameda() intentionally supports only API routes that return useful data:

  • "small_fccs" is blocked by the API route used by the Transparency search.
  • "centers" maps to a sparse legacy API bucket.

For small FCC enumeration, use the CKAN snapshot in chekos/ccld-open-data-snapshot. For center workflows, use "preschools".

What does the 250-result cap warning mean?

The CCLD search endpoint can cap individual responses at 250 records. To reduce that risk, ccld_alameda() queries each Alameda city separately. If a city still reports 250 or more results, the function warns because additional facilities may be hidden by the API response cap.

How do I force fresh data?

Use cache = FALSE for one call:

ccld_verify("13423996", cache = FALSE)

Clear the whole cache before a reproducibility run:

ccld_cache_clear()

Inspect cached responses:

ccld_cache_info()

How do I see API requests?

Set verbose mode before running a workflow:

options(ccldr.verbose = TRUE)

Slow down batch requests when running larger jobs:

options(ccldr.delay = 1)

How should I run documentation checks locally?

Run the same core checks used for this package:

roxygen2::roxygenise()
testthat::test_local(reporter = "summary")
pkgdown::build_site()
devtools::check(error_on = "never")

If a check fails only while executing live API examples, move that example into a website-only article or make the chunk conditional.
